cases.statement: Raw subjects preserve all thirteen parsed Raw fields, real declarative documents and physical byte associations without inventing historical input.
Raw analysis and canonical validation use the actual same nine-member context object and exact partition without a fabricated resolver.
Raw physical bytes, parsed declarations, diagnostic presentation, canonical validation and Checked states remain distinct; parser failure is not a port predicate.
The single positive_unique_io_ports case preserves the actual input-before-output stable numeric sort and reached positivity/uniqueness check before schema resolution.
Raw Source, exact schema constraint Target, original and sorted port Coordinate and both declarative paths identify the same real occurrence.
Zero and duplicate violations retain complete typed U32 occurrences and real predecessor evidence; positive facts have no contradiction and diagnostic strings cannot supply evidence.
Raw prerequisites and typed member references retain original stage and origin, all observations and consumers; one local positive port does not prove namespace coverage.
Future branch-created evidence is borrowed before diagnostic reduction; source, context and evidence lifetimes cannot produce a Checked token or trusted caller assertion.
Raw input Scope excludes generated facts and witnesses, whose separate finite DAGs and non-root fragment cannot convert to CompleteView.
All Raw descriptors, parent extensions and member paths are closed, width-exact, ranked and field-complete while historical descriptors retain their original owners.
The exact Raw successor binds complete registered content with separate Registered, NotImplemented and NotAuthorized states; old and mixed identities fail closed.
